objectives.description: Smoke landing, signup, login, and 404 in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Generate concise visual evidence without full-page duplicates.
Verify privacy and terms links on collection surfaces.
objectives.blocker: Login, activation, forgot-password, and reset-password collection surfaces do not expose Privacy and Terms links at 360x800, 390x844, tablet, or desktop. The fix belongs to shared auth/account-lifecycle source outside this evidence lane.

objectives.description: Verify communications route readiness, customer-safe failure behavior, and responsive layout.
objectives.blocker: /app/communications returns a 404/error document instead of the app shell, exposes technical diagnostics, and overflows at 390x844 (scrollWidth 923, bodyScrollWidth 915). The fix belongs to the communications/app routing owner.

objectives.description: Verify major browser mobile overflow behavior.
objectives.blocker: WebKit 390x844 landing page has horizontal overflow (clientWidth 390, scrollWidth 1648, bodyScrollWidth 1640). The fix belongs to the public responsive CSS owner.

objectives.description: Verify error association and live-region behavior on collection surfaces.
objectives.blocker: Signup, login, and forgot-password expose focusable data-error-for targets, but visible fields are missing aria-describedby links to the error nodes. The fix belongs to shared form markup source outside this lane.
